title: Budget Cuts
source_credit: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English Level 2, Lesson 1. Human VOA audio; WorldVoice provides only a selected, bilingual transcript excerpt; read the full conversation on the credited official page. No sentence timings have been verified. WorldVoice is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: So, Jonathan, what do you think today's meeting is about? The email sounded important.
dialogue.translation_ar: جوناثان، ما رأيك في موضوع اجتماع اليوم؟ بدت الرسالة الإلكترونية مهمة.

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.text: Well, I have heard people in the building talking about budget cuts.
dialogue.translation_ar: سمعت أشخاصًا في المبنى يتحدثون عن تخفيضات الميزانية.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Oh! Budget cuts? Wait, who has been talking about budget cuts?
dialogue.translation_ar: أوه، تخفيضات الميزانية؟ انتظر، من الذي يتحدث عنها؟

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Mark in Accounting? That's one person. That's not “people.”
dialogue.translation_ar: مارك من المحاسبة؟ هذا شخص واحد، وليس أشخاصًا!

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.text: I know, but Mark knows everything that goes on at The Studio.
dialogue.translation_ar: أعلم، لكن مارك يعرف كل ما يحدث في الاستوديو.
